global_rules.default_standard: Use new national standard by default: query_city_standard_report with ns_type=2. Use ns_type=1 only when the user explicitly asks for old standard.
global_rules.city_name_format: Use short Chinese city names without the 市 suffix, for example 广州 not 广州市

result_vs_report_data_id.result: API statistical report records. Use this for final answers, reports, rankings, exceedance counts, primary pollutant ratios, and composite index analysis.
result_vs_report_data_id.report_data_id: Stored full API report package. Use read_data_registry views cities/raw/result for complete records.

strategies.statistics_report: Use query_city_standard_report for city statistics and query_station_standard_report for station statistics: composite index, valid days, exceed days, compliance rate, pollutant statistics, primary pollutant statistics, rankings, and new/old national standard reports.
strategies.trend_comparison: Use query_city_standard_yoy_report for city year-over-year/month-over-month/two-period comparison and query_station_standard_yoy_report for station comparison. Do not recompute air-quality statistics or local YoY from daily data.
strategies.standard_comparison: Use query_city_standard_report or query_station_standard_report twice for the same period: ns_type=2 and ns_type=1.
strategies.national_ranking: Use execute_sql_query against national/168-city statistic tables for national ranking. Do not use Guangdong-only tools for national ranking.
strategies.station_query: Use station tools when the user gives station names, station codes, monitoring points, or asks station-level questions.
strategies.hourly_query: Use hourly tools for hourly process, peak hour, diurnal change, or time-of-day questions.
strategies.sql_query: Use SQL Server syntax. Prefix Chinese string literals with N. Prefer precomputed ranking fields when available.

query_city_standard_report.purpose: Query Guangdong city statistical report through the official API for either new or old national standard.
misuse: Do not query daily data just to calculate statistics already returned by this API.
Do not call deprecated query_new_standard_report or query_old_standard_report.

query_city_standard_yoy_report.purpose: Query Guangdong city comparative statistical report through the official API for either new or old national standard.
misuse: Do not query two single-period reports just to manually calculate city YoY/period comparison when this API comparison tool applies.
Do not query daily data just to calculate YoY statistics.

query_gd_suncere_city_day_new.purpose: Query new-standard city daily air quality records.
misuse: Do not use this just to calculate summary statistics that query_city_standard_report already returns.

query_gd_suncere_city_hour.purpose: Query city hourly air quality data.
misuse: Do not use hourly data for simple period statistics when query_city_standard_report is available.

query_gd_suncere_station_hour_new.purpose: Query station-level hourly data under the new standard.
query_gd_suncere_station_hour_new.conditional_params: Provide at least one of cities or stations.
misuse: Do not answer station-level questions with city-level data unless explicitly allowed.

query_station_standard_report.purpose: Query Guangdong station statistical report through the official API for either new or old national standard.
query_station_standard_report.conditional_params: Provide at least one of cities or stations.
misuse: Do not use city-level report tools for station-level statistics.
Do not query daily data just to calculate statistics already returned by this API.

query_station_standard_yoy_report.purpose: Query Guangdong station comparative statistical report through the official API for either new or old national standard.
query_station_standard_yoy_report.conditional_params: Provide at least one of cities or stations.
misuse: Do not query two single-period reports just to manually calculate station YoY/period comparison when this API comparison tool applies.
Do not query daily data just to calculate YoY statistics.

execute_sql_query.purpose: Execute SQL Server queries for tables, rankings, joins, and unsupported specialized queries.
misuse: Do not guess unknown table columns; request table description first if needed.
Do not use SQL to hand-calculate statistics already returned by report tools.
Do not forget N prefix for Chinese string literals.
